messages:
jess_sales: Heads up — enterprise prospect (FinServ) asking for a 6-week POC. Need scoping sync: security questionnaire, pricing guardrails, and model fit for 32k docs + tool calls. Who can join today?
anya_solutions: I can. Quick note: they want search + rerank over internal docs + tool calling to fetch transactions. Constraint: data must never leave their VPC. Also want invoice-classification embed pipeline.
sam_eng: We should propose Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC peering. For model: suggest testing a 32k-capable variant + a smaller reranker. Need to confirm true context requirement — is it 32k for single prompt or across conversation?
jess_sales: They specifically said "32k context" and toolcall for `payment_api`. Security items: SOC2, in-region key rotation, and customer-managed KMS. Price sensitivity: target < $0.02 / 1k tokens if possible.
matt_infra: VPC/private is doable. Blocker: they require mutual TLS with customer-managed CA, that typically adds ~2–3 weeks for cert provisioning. Also need KMS/HSM integration support.
rose_legal: Add data retention clause + audit log access to contract. We'll need sample (redacted) logs for our security review.
anya_solutions: POC success criteria proposal:
- 1) Retrieval + rerank precision@5 >= 0.8 on their eval set
- 2) Latency p95 < 500ms (end-to-end)
- 3) Tool-call reliability >= 99.5%
- 4) Zero public egress of raw customer data
Thoughts? :thinking_face:
sam_eng: Agree on goals but p95 500ms might be tight with full 32k + rerank. Suggest initial SLO p95 = 800ms, stretch to 500ms with Dedicated + quantization and prefix caching. Recommend embedding index (FAISS/HNSW) + small cross-encoder reranker to reduce cost.
jess_sales: Customer's business metric: "95% of answers match SMEs." They can provide a 200-query eval set and labelled ground truth. We should compare embed+rerank vs generation baseline.
anya_solutions: I'll draft an eval plan. Need prompt templates and ground truth. Eval harness sketch:
```
eval_config:
  queries: 200
  metrics: [precision_at_5, recall_at_10, latency_p95]
  models: [redwood-32k-quant, redwood-16k-fast, reranker-small]
  data: s3://customer/poc-evals
```
matt_infra: Also confirm whether they allow token-level logging for quality monitoring. If not, we need hashed prefixes for eval and aggregate telemetry only.
security-bot: security-bot: Received security questionnaire (attached). High-priority items: KMS attestation, network flow logs, recent penetration test report. Marking dev@infra for follow-up.
jess_sales: Timeline proposal:
- Week 0: infra & certs provisioning
- Week 1-2: ingest + build index, eval harness
- Week 3: run initial evals, iterate prompts
- Week 4-5: canary with subset of traffic, ops runbook
- Week 6: wrap, handoff + final report
Anyone object?
sam_eng: Works if infra starts this week. Cost estimate for Dedicated baseline: ~ $12k/month pro-rated + eng support hours. Need go/no-go by EOD to hit kickoff.
rose_legal: I'll start contract review. Need their DPA, export controls, and proof of lawful data processing.
anya_solutions: I'll assemble deliverables and owners. CC @matt_infra for TLS, @sam_eng for model selection, @rose_legal for contract items.
jess_sales: :thumbsup: I'll schedule kickoff with customer tomorrow 10am PT and request the 200-query eval set + a redacted doc sample.
sam_eng: Quick model notes: rerank approach = embed search (dim=1024) + small cross-encoder for final sort. Quantize candidate models to 4-bit where possible for cost savings.
anya_solutions: Action items (owners + due):
1) Jess: get eval set + doc samples (due tomorrow)
2) Matt: start cert/KMS prep + provide ETA (due 48h)
3) Sam: provision Dedicated estimate + suggest model variants (due 48h)
4) Rose: contract redline checklist (due 72h)
jess_sales: Noted. If any blocker > 2 days call me and we'll escalate to enterprise support.
security-bot: security-bot: Flag — customer says HSM-backed keys are mandatory and must be in-region. That may force on-prem or Private with customer HSM integration.
sam_eng: If HSM is required on-prem, timeline shifts to 8–10 weeks. Need to surface to customer immediately.
jess_sales: I'll confirm HSM requirement in kickoff tomorrow.
anya_solutions: I'll draft the POC one-pager and share here after the call. Link to template: https://redwood.ai/docs/poc-template
jess_sales: Thanks team — will update after kickoff. :rocket:
